title: Lead tracking and quotations for interior and service businesses
desc: A pipeline board, a web enquiry form that feeds it, follow-up reminders, shareable quotations and win and loss reports. A concept build for interior designers, contractors and service firms.
tag: For interior designers, contractors and service firms
h1: Never lose an enquiry because nobody called back.
lead: Every enquiry from Instagram, Justdial, your website form or a phone call lands on one board. You see who to call today, send a quotation link and learn why jobs are won or lost.
fEyebrow: From the first message to the signed quote
fH2: What a small sales team needs to close more jobs
features: Move each lead through new, contacted, site visit, quote sent and negotiation. See the value sitting in every stage.
An enquiry form for your website
Share one link or embed it. Each submission becomes a lead with its source tagged, so nothing sits in a WhatsApp chat.
Every open lead has a next date. Today's list shows who to call, and overdue ones are marked so they do not slip.
Pick items from your rate list, add a discount and send a link. The client views it on their phone and accepts it there.
A full history for each lead
Calls, site visits and notes are saved in order, so anyone on the team can pick up the conversation.
See which source brings paying clients, how long jobs take to close and the reasons you lose them.
splits: See every job on one board
Drag leads between stages and watch the value of each column. Filter by owner or source.
Start the day with a call list
Overdue, due today and coming up, grouped so the team knows what to do first.
One tap to log a call
A form that fills the board for you
Visitors describe their home and budget. You get a new lead with the source set to website.
Send a quote the client can accept
A clean quotation with items, discount and validity date. Accepting it marks the lead as won.
hEyebrow: Ready before your next site visit
steps: Add the items you quote most often, with prices. Quotes pick from this list.
Put it on your Instagram bio, Google profile and website. Every enquiry lands on the board.
Work through today's list, send a quote link and move the lead forward.
faq: Can the form go on my own website?
Yes. The enquiry form is a single page you can link to or embed. A production build would also post straight to your database.
Can clients accept a quote online?
In the demo the quote page has an accept button that marks the lead as won. A live build can also record a signature and take an advance by UPI.
Is this connected to Instagram or Justdial?
Not in the demo. A live build can pull enquiries from email alerts or lead forms into the same board.
No. Leads, quotes and the team are generated for a made-up studio called Bright Interiors.
ctaH: Send an enquiry and watch it arrive.
ctaP: Fill the enquiry form as a customer, then open the CRM and find your lead on the board.
